decisions.reason: Product A has the longest investment and prominent website presence, so escalation of commitment makes management reluctant to drop it despite limited recent information.
Although less investment than A, its own webpage signals public commitment and no clear failure evidence, so management persists.
The firm has committed to the product with a dedicated page and lacks clear signals of lasting poor results, leading to escalation-based retention.
Similar to the other waste products, prior investment and public visibility incline management to keep it despite missing recent web archival.
